sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the table-selection logic to match dependencyContract.tableModel exactly: the current rank branches are wrong for multiple bands, including normal-strength material class 1 (10–15 mm and 35–40 mm), high-tensile material classes 1 and 2 above 35 mm, and high-tensile material class 3 for PC4–5 at 35–45 mm. Do not derive applicability and required rank from the incorrect hard-coded branches. Enforce the exact selected required grade from Table 8, not merely presence plus rank: constrain requiredHullStructuralSteelGrade to the table's exact controlled value for the matching thickness, Polar Class group, material class, and strength category, and ensure its grade family matches steelStrengthCategory. Retain the NOT_APPLICABLE exception only for the explicitly declared normal-strength/material-class-3/PC1–5 combinations above 35 mm.

Enforce the exact selected required grade, its family, and the family-scoped actual-grade rank comparison, while retaining only the declared normal-strength/class-3/PC1–5 NOT_APPLICABLE combinations.
